subject: Model crashing in LOOCV that runs on full dataset

messages.author: f2baaf6252beabe3
messages.subject: Model crashing in LOOCV that runs on full dataset
parts:
Hi all, 

I'm running LOOCV on a Linux cluster. All of my models (13 in total) ran without error on the full dataset, but a few are crashing now ("The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
"). 

In order to troubleshoot these, I'd like to change my code to re-run with verbose=TRUE and save the output *if* this error is produced, and continue with the next model if there's no error. Do you have any tips for how to code this?

Thanks,
Julianne

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Model crashing in LOOCV that runs on full dataset
parts:
if inla() fail, it will not return anything, so 'r' would no exists.

rm("r")
r = inla(y~1,data = data.frame(y=-1),family='poisson');

if (!exists("r")) {
## failed

}

messages.author: 334c7505e0b5cf65
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Model crashing in LOOCV that runs on full dataset
parts:
so that's why you would need

rm('r')

otherwise you just get the old one

I often wrap my inla call within 'try()’ when running lost of models within loops or in parallel to check that the model run smoothly and make sure that the code does not stop if a model gives an error. You may also want to consider this.

Best,

Virgilio
